title: Philips, Edwards roll out real-time AI for heart implant procedures
summary: Philips and Edwards Lifesciences aim to assist interventional cardiologists in placing minimally invasive valve implants with an AI-powered GPS for the heart.

title: Trump takes aim at insurance industry, drug prices in unveiling 'The Great Healthcare Plan'
summary: President Donald Trump has hinted at "concepts of a plan" for healthcare for months as legislators debate the future of key subsidies under the Affordable Care Act, and on Thursday the White House unveiled a more concrete version of their vision for health policy.

title: Break Your Back Testing
summary: How much backtesting should a beginner realistically aim for in a year to see real improvement?
